caption: The video captures a rain-slicked street at night, where vivid pink, red, and yellow neon light smears across the wet pavement in shimmering streaks. The view opens partly blocked by a large close foreground silhouette, then shifts to reveal the full dark shapes of two people standing side by side against the luminous backdrop. As the framing changes, the silhouettes alter in size and position, and parked cars and additional neon sources emerge along the right edge. The reflections on the soaked surface continue to flicker and shift in tone throughout.
relations: The close foreground silhouette partially occludes the scene until the camera pans to reveal two side-by-side figures.
Wet pavement mirrors the neon colors, so the reflections shimmer and shift in tone as the framing changes.
As the view widens rightward, parked cars and additional neon sources emerge along the right edge.
The two dark figures persist against the luminous backdrop while their apparent size and position alter with framing.
